name: Brick Traversal
aliases: Ray Marching with Alpha Compositing & Sample Ratio Adjustment
definition: A ray marching loop that samples a brick texture, adjusts alpha/RGB for variable step sizes, and composites the result into a destination color using front-to-back alpha blending.
summary: Brick Traversal is a ray-marching kernel that samples volumetric bricks and composites colors using front-to-back alpha blending, distinguished by adjusting sampling density via a sample ratio for variable step sizes.
